facts.text: Robin, there's one pot of stew and a lot of folks. Pass it around and save the end for Friar Tuck.
facts.why: Little John doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. A real food line is Friar Tuck tasting the overcooked chow: 'Well-done, ain't it?'

facts.text: The archery tournament with a golden arrow
facts.why: The sources opened say the prize is a kiss from Maid Marian and don't mention a golden arrow.
facts.fix: The archery tournament with a kiss from Maid Marian as the prize

vibe.verdict: The animal cast and camp feel are right, but the dishes could use more of the film's gags.
missing: The Phony King of England song (hideout)
Robin in disguise as the Devonshire stork (archery tournament)
The Sheriff taking the last farthing from the poor box
ideas: Swap 'Outlaws' camp stew' note for Friar Tuck's overcooked chow.
Swap 'Golden coin honey cakes' for a poor box farthing cake.
Add a stork-shaped bread roll replacing 'Archery tournament skewers' note.
Swap 'Prince John's mustard roast beef' note for Prince John's thumb.
